name: Nayeli Citlali
description:
Nayeli Citlali is not exactly a private investigator, though she's licensed as one. She is an information broker — someone who collects, synthesizes, trades, and weaponizes knowledge. Every conversation she has is simultaneously social and transactional. Every relationship is genuine and exploitable. She exists at the center of a web of intelligence that spans all five tiers of GLMZ, and her real product isn't investigation — it's understanding.

Her network is her masterwork. Over fifteen years, she has cultivated sources in every meaningful institution in the city: corporate employees who share gossip for pocket money, CorpSec officers who trade case details for favors, tunnel dwellers who report on underground movement for food credits, service workers in the Spires who overhear conversations their employers forget they're present for. No single source knows anything critical. The power is in the synthesis — combining a hundred fragments of mundane information into a picture that reveals something nobody wanted revealed.

She is frequently hired as an investigator but her real business is the information exchange itself. Clients come to her because they need to know something. She already knows it, or she knows who knows it, or she can find out within 48 hours. Her fee structure is unusual: sometimes she charges Quanta, sometimes she charges in information, and sometimes she charges in future favors. The favor economy is her real currency. Half the powerful people in GLMZ owe her something, and she collects when the time is right.
affiliation: Independent — operates a gray-market information exchange alongside investigation services
location: A shifting series of meeting points across the Circuit — never the same place twice in a month, near North Ave and Milwaukee
specialization: Information brokerage and intelligence synthesis — she doesn't find people, she finds secrets
methods: Maintaining a vast network of informants across all five tiers who trade intelligence for favors, protection, or cash
Cross-referencing data from multiple sources to identify patterns invisible to any single source
Trading information between clients — one client's answer is often another client's question
Operating dead-drop networks for secure information exchange
Cultivating relationships with data workers, administrators, and bureaucrats who have access to databases
notable_cases: Assembled a complete financial profile of a Tier 5 executive using only information gathered from the executive's household staff, dry cleaner, and vehicle mechanic — never accessed a single database
Prevented a gang war in the Circuit by trading the right piece of information to the right person at the right time — seven words that saved approximately forty lives
Identified the real owner of a shell company that had been laundering money for three separate criminal organizations — sold the information to all three, then sold their reactions to a fourth party
equipment: Nothing electronic that can be tracked — she operates entirely through human networks and physical dead drops
A memory palace technique that allows her to store vast amounts of information without writing anything down
Multiple identity documents for accessing different tiers
A collection of favors owed to her by people in positions of power — her most valuable possession
Poison capsule in a false tooth — last resort if captured by someone who wants her information extracted by force
personality: Hadiya is the most sociable person in any room and simultaneously the most unknowable. Sudanese-Czech-Ghanaian heritage, thirty-eight years old, with warm brown skin, wide dark eyes, and a smile that makes people want to confide in her — a weaponized charisma she has refined over decades. She genuinely enjoys people, which is what makes her so dangerous: her interest in your problems is real, her sympathy is authentic, and she will absolutely use everything you tell her if the price is right. She operates by a personal code — she never trades information that will get children harmed, she never reveals a source, and she never lies about what she knows. Everything else is negotiable.

relationships.name: The Bartender
relationships.description: An anonymous figure who operates a Circuit bar and functions as her primary message relay — nobody knows their real name, including Hadiya

relationships.name: Cassiel Brandt-Ouedraogo
relationships.description: Hadiya has assembled enough fragments to suspect his kidnapping scheme but lacks the final piece — she's waiting

story_hooks: Someone begins assassinating Hadiya's sources across multiple tiers simultaneously — the attack is too coordinated to be personal and too targeted to be random
She acquires a piece of information so dangerous that every faction in GLMZ would kill to possess or suppress it — and she can't trade it without starting a war

A new information broker appears in the Circuit with impossible access — someone with a network that rivals Hadiya's, built in months instead of years, suggesting technological assistance she doesn't understand

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora synthesis: Indigenous American (40.3%), Sub-Saharan African (24.9%), Southeast Asian (19.0%), Eastern European (8.9%), East Asian (6.9%). The combination produces a phenotype of striking integration — warm medium brown skin with golden and subtle reddish undertones from Indigenous American and African ancestry, bone structure showing high prominent cheekbones characteristic of Southeast and East Asian heritage combined with the angular jawline definition from Indigenous American genetics, creating a face that is simultaneously delicate and severe. The structural influences from Eastern European ancestry add subtle depth to facial planes while maintaining the warmth of her primary ancestry groups.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, shoulders slightly narrow but defined through careful maintenance rather than natural muscularity. The kind of frame that moves efficiently through crowds without drawing attention — economical, controlled.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver streaking at the temples and along the left side, left unretouched as a calculated choice
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid that starts at the crown and ends mid-back. No ornamentation. The style reads as deliberate restraint.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and constantly evaluating
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden and subtle reddish undertones, reflecting the synthesis of Indigenous American, Sub-Saharan African, and Southeast Asian heritage with structural influences from Eastern European ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Kept meticulously maintained but without the sheen of expensive cosmetics — this is hygiene, not vanity. Fine lines around the eyes from constant focus work and reading small text. A small scar through the left eyebrow (old, well-healed) that she makes no effort to conceal. Jawline prominent and unmarked, cheekbones high and defined with the characteristic structure of her Southeast Asian and Indigenous American ancestry. Facial planes show subtle depth from Eastern European influence.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running through the left eyebrow, approximately 2cm, jagged from impact rather than surgery
Small circular burn mark on the inside of the right wrist, approximately 5mm diameter, old enough to be pale against her skin — consistent with interrogation-era violence or a calculated accident
Faint constellation of dots along the inside of her left forearm, too regular to be natural, suggesting subcutaneous implant scarring or selective dermal modification
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None obvious at first glance. However, upon closer inspection: her pupils reflect light unusually — suggesting either advanced ocular implants or contact-based augmentation. The faint scarring on her left forearm hints at subcutaneous work, but nothing chrome or obvious. She operates in the space between visible and invisible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stillness is her default state. She sits perfectly upright in meetings, weight balanced, hands visible on the table. Her movements are minimal and purposeful — no fidgeting, no nervous tics. When she walks, her gait is direct and economical. She listens more than she speaks, head tilted at a slight angle as if every word is being parsed and cross-referenced in real time. Her eyes rarely break contact, and when they do, it's to observe something in the environment, not from discomfort.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 professional wear with Tier 2 precision. She favors charcoal and black — a high-end wool blend coat (no logos, no corporate markers), slim-fit dark trousers, and a series of neutral turtlenecks or simple button-ups in cream, grey, or black. The shoes are always maintained leather, expensive enough to last years but unremarkable in style. She wears a single piece of jewelry: a thin bracelet made from brushed steel or similar matte metal, nothing decorative. Her clothing is deliberately unremarkable — the goal is to be forgotten immediately after being seen. Everything fits perfectly, suggesting either custom tailoring or meticulous personal maintenance. No visible corporate or faction markers. A simple messenger bag, worn leather, always with her.
